sourceD2: D2/native-shell-engine linear-elastic QUAD4; three independent solved geometries with actual integrations
numericalScope: Educational diagnostic FEM stress visualizations of three distinct 2D planar shell meshes, neither actual designed buildings nor code-certified results.

cases.descriptionIt: Soletta piana in C.A. elasticamente vincolata lungo il bordo occidentale; due asole strutturali, due bordi incastrati, 3,8 kN/m² verticali e shell QUAD4 originali.
cases.descriptionEn: Irregular reinforced-concrete plate, west and south edges clamped, two genuine voids, downward 3.8 kN/m² load and native QUAD4 shell elements.
cases.stressRecovery: Elastic top/bottom local face σ from native Kratos Gauss resultants: N/h ± 6M/h², kN/m² to MPa. No nodal stress recovery.
cases.numericalLimits: Independent diagnostic shell model; no structure built, no code compliance, no calibrated soil, no collapse or capacity inferred.
